in_urdu.name: Naafi
in_urdu.meaning: اسلامی نام جس کا مطلب ہے Given to
in_urdu.long_meaning: Naafi ایک اسلامی نام ہے جو مسلم ثقافت میں گہری روحانی اہمیت رکھتا ہے۔ Derived from the Arabic root 'n-f-f' meaning 'to give' or 'to feed'. In Islamic history, Naafi ibn al-Masud (ra) was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) known for his generosity and hospitality.

in_hindi.name: Naafi
in_hindi.meaning: इस्लामी नाम जिसका अर्थ है Given to
in_hindi.long_meaning: Naafi एक इस्लामी नाम है जो मुस्लिम संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Arabic root 'n-f-f' meaning 'to give' or 'to feed'. In Islamic history, Naafi ibn al-Masud (ra) was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) known for his generosity and hospitality.

in_pashto.name: Naafi
in_pashto.meaning: اسلامي نوم چې معنی یې ده Given to
in_pashto.long_meaning: Naafi یو اسلامي نوم دی چې په مسلم کلتور کې ژوره روحاني اهميت لري. Derived from the Arabic root 'n-f-f' meaning 'to give' or 'to feed'. In Islamic history, Naafi ibn al-Masud (ra) was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) known for his generosity and hospitality.
